{{Top|leg}}
'''Hoag's Decant''' was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The last known location of the [[Ghostling Nest of the Assembler|Ghostling Nest]] of the [[Kud'ar Mub'at|Assembler]] was located near Hoag's Decant.<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>
